title: Vanilla Berry Protein Waffle Bowl | 43g Protein | 383 Calories
description: Creamy vanilla protein yogurt, fresh strawberries, and four warm Eggo Protein waffle halves make this easy breakfast with approximately 43 grams of protein and 383 calories.
image_prompt: A realistic high-protein breakfast bowl filled with thick creamy vanilla Greek yogurt and topped only with sliced fresh strawberries. The waffle pieces must retain rounded outer edges and clearly look like halves of circular waffles, not sticks, rectangles, or wedges. No blueberries, hemp hearts, syrup, or other unlisted ingredients. Bright clean natural food photography with soft daylight.
